Baltoy

Ground Psychic

Hoenn · Generation 3

Baltoy is a Ground/Psychic-type Clay Doll Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 0.5 m tall and weighs 21.5 kg. It evolves into Claydol. Its highest base stat is Sp. Def (70), with a base stat total of 300.
